title: Genuinely useful
body: I can find myself “stuck” in my routines, and this app helps me snap out of it and just get it done. I use it every time I get ready in the morning and before bed, for a couple of years now probably. This app does have its occasional bug lol, but it probably means it’s a smaller team. I recommend the app and honestly just glad it exists. Genuinely taught me a new way to approach my every day routines .
author: Lihys_
